artworks.title: Two Men beside Two Trees
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a winding path leading into rugged terrain. Trees are scattered throughout, and the sky is partially obscured by clouds. The brushstrokes are detailed, creating texture in the rocks and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, gray, and white. Near the forefront, there are detailed tree roots and rocks, while further back, the path and hills lead towards a faint horizon.

artworks.title: Traveler by a Waterfall
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from a slightly elevated view. The horizon is positioned in the upper third of the image, guiding the eye towards distant hills and a faint mountain shape. Along the horizon, there are clusters of trees and a meandering waterway. In the foreground, tall trees with dense foliage dominate the scene, and a small waterfall cascades into a pool. The scene is depicted in fine, detailed etching, with delicate line work and cross-hatching creating texture and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of black, white, and gray.

artworks.title: Cattle Drover in an Italian Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a high horizon, featuring buildings on the left, rocky terrain, trees, a mountain range in the distance, and people on a countryside path. The sky has scattered clouds and the scene is depicted in black ink on white paper. The drawing includes detailed cross-hatching for texture.

artworks.title: Traveler Pointing the Way
artworks.description: This image features a landscape with intricate black-and-white etching. The viewpoint is elevated, showing a path amidst trees and rocks. Trees dominate the foreground, with detailed cross-hatching. Beyond, hills and trees surround a rocky hillside. The distance shows lighter, less detailed lines for depth. The monochromatic palette emphasizes contrast, enhancing the landscape's textures.

artworks.title: Rider on a Path
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a rural landscape. The view shows a dirt path lined with trees stretching into the distance. The sky above has clouds, rendered with minimal linework. In the distance on the path, there are two figures - one on horseback and one walking. The style includes detailed hatching and cross-hatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and white. Trees are depicted with dark and light tones, creating depth in the scene.

artworks.title: Rider on a Path by a Waterfall
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a slightly elevated point. The horizon is low, with distant mountains and a partially cloudy sky. A large tree with detailed leaves and trunk stands in the foreground. A path leads into the image, with two figures - one on a horse and the other on foot. A rocky formation is visible on the left, adding depth to the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, typical of a black-and-white etching. Textural detail is achieved through hatching and cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Trees by a River
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape seen from a slightly elevated viewpoint overlooking a body of water towards a cluster of trees. The horizon appears high in the composition with the sky above. The scene shows trees, a hill, water, and hills in the distance. The artwork uses detailed etching techniques with fine hatched lines to create texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, mostly sepia or dark tones. In the foreground, intricate details are visible in the trees and water.

artworks.title: Oberland Bernois
artworks.description: The image depicts a mountainous landscape with a waterfall cascading into a valley. The composition shows rugged mountain peaks under a cloudy sky. Trees and rocky slopes surround the valley, with a stream winding through the scene. Rocks, trees, and mountains are finely detailed using an etching technique. The ground texture is textured with heavy brushstrokes, focusing on rocks and a stream. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing depth and detail through varying shades of a single color, and enhancing light and shadow contrast.

artworks.title: Herd in a Stream
artworks.description: The etching depicts a landscape with a path or stream. In the distance, several cows and a figure are visible beside the water. Trees and foliage dominate the background, with clouds delicately etched in the sky. The scene is predominantly in shades of sepia and black, emphasizing the detailed line work defining the natural elements, conveying a sense of tranquility.

artworks.title: Cliffs in a Storm
artworks.description: The image shows a low-angle perspective of towering cliffs on the right side. The horizon is positioned low in the composition, where the land meets the sky in the distance. The cliffs display intricate etching techniques, with fine, dense crosshatching creating a textured surface. The clouds in the sky are defined with swirling lines, suggesting movement. Rocks are scattered along a path leading further into the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white to create contrast and highlight the landscape's details.

artworks.title: Couple in a Clearing
artworks.description: The image shows a path going through a dense forest with tall trees dominating the scene. The horizon is low, obscured by the woods, placing emphasis on the sky above with soft clouds. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing textures of foliage and tree bark. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and white for contrast between shadows and light. Two small figures can be seen walking along the path in the distance under the canopy.

artworks.title: Ancient Trees on a Hillside
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The terrain has a gentle incline, and the horizon is low with a grouping of trees partially obscuring it. The scene is detailed with intricate linework, mimicking natural textures of leaves and branches. In the distance are faint outlines of hills or mountains blending with the sky. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia and brown tones. A winding path leads towards the trees, bordered by grass and rocks.

artworks.title: Trees at the Foot of a Cliff
artworks.description: The image shows a rugged landscape with a rocky cliff on the right side. The horizon line is obscured by the cliffs, trees, and distant peaks. The artwork includes textured details with hatching and cross-hatching to represent the cliffs and clouds. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of black, grey, and white for depth and contrast. Rocks, trees, cliffs, mountains, and clouds are depicted in the scene.

artworks.title: Mountain Waterfall
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a rocky terrain, trees, and mountains in the distance. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, capturing a comprehensive view. The horizon is not clearly visible as the mountains dominate the scene. The artwork appears to use fine lines and crosshatching typical of etching to depict texture. The image is monochromatic with varying shades of gray. A small waterfall is visible close by, with a dense forest beyond leading up the mountains.

artworks.title: Mountain Stream
artworks.description: The image shows a valley between mountains with a high horizon filled with jagged peaks. Some mountains have snow-capped tops. A cluster of trees is near a stream that curves through rocky terrain. The etching style includes detailed linework showing textures of the foliage and rocks. The color palette is monochrome using black and gray shades to depict depth, texture, and shadow.

artworks.title: Essais de gravure à l'eau forte par Alexandre Calame, I, pl. 21
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a group of goats on rocky ground in the foreground. Tall pine trees stand to the right, and a river flows through the terrain towards mountains in the distance. The mountains are covered in snow, under a textured sky. The scene is depicted using fine lines and cross-hatching, in a monochrome color scheme, resembling a classical etching.

artworks.title: Grove of Trees
artworks.description: This image shows a cluster of tall, leafy trees dominating the center. The horizon is low, blending into the distant land with two figures. The sky has fine, horizontal lines suggesting clouds. The artwork uses detailed etching to depict texture, with a monochromatic brown palette. Rocks and sparse vegetation are seen closer, leading the eye to the trees.

artworks.title: Deer by a Stream
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a small stream running diagonally across. The foreground shows two figures near the water's edge, one standing with a stick and the other sitting down. A textured tree dominates the left side, with rough bark and a large canopy. The horizon is low, with a rising hill in the distance under a sky filled with wispy clouds. The sky is delicately painted, contrasting with the detailed foliage and tree trunk. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and white. In the background, more trees and a human figure are visible up the stream.

artworks.title: Trees by a River
artworks.description: The etching depicts a landscape with detailed trees on the right side, framing the scene. A water body reflects the sky and trees, with a distant mountain range visible. The finely-detailed lines create intricate patterns in the leaves and bark. The monochrome color palette adds depth and highlights light and shadow. Three figures in light attire stand in the background.

artworks.title: Mountain Meadow
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed etching of a landscape featuring a mountain range, rocky terrain with a waterfall, and tall trees in the foreground. The mountains have intricate line work and the color palette is mostly brown and earth tones. Wispy clouds fill the sky in the background.

artworks.title: Riders by a Pond
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a small body of water surrounded by dense vegetation. Large trees with detailed leaves and branches tower over the scene. In the background, a pathway leads into the distance where figures and a dog are visible. The sky above has various cloud formations. The artwork primarily uses black and white colors to emphasize light and shadow.

artworks.title: Laundresses
artworks.description: The image depicts a riverside scene with a horizon dividing the sky and land. Clouds are visible along the horizon, with horizontal striations in the sky. A tree bends over a river, and two figures are seen in the water near the reeds. The artwork features detailed hatching to convey texture and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown.

artworks.title: Mountain Stream
artworks.description: The image shows a mountain landscape with a low horizon, towering mountains dominating the central and left parts. Rugged peaks are seen in the distance against a sky filled with textured clouds. The artwork features intricate lines depicting rocky surfaces and clouds. The color scheme is primarily brown, providing a timeless appearance. A river flows past rocks and sparse vegetation, surrounded by scattered trees.

artworks.title: Mountain River
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on chine collé
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a high horizon, showcasing distant mountains under a cloudy sky. A waterfall is seen to the left, with a river flowing in the foreground, reflecting rocks in the water. A dense forest of tall trees is depicted in dark, detailed strokes. The brushstrokes capture textures of foliage and rocks, creating depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and sepia.
